name: GitHub Org Hygiene — scheduled scan & alert

nodes.name: Run scan (Python core)
nodes.notes: Requires Python 3.9+ and the github_hygiene package on the n8n host (or a custom Docker image). GITHUB_TOKEN is injected from the host environment / n8n credentials — never hard-coded here. Read-only token.

nodes.notes: Swap for Slack / Teams / PagerDuty as needed. SMTP credentials configured in n8n, not in the workflow.
